title: Chapter 2 - Most Used Kinds of APIs
description: Quick concept check on common API types.

questions.prompt: Which API style is most common on the web?

explanations.overview: REST is the most common on the web.

byOptionId.a: Correct. REST is the most used.
byOptionId.b: Not quite. SOAP is older and less common.
byOptionId.c: Not quite. gRPC is common between services.
byOptionId.d: Not quite. WebSocket is for live connections.

options.label: You ask for exactly the fields you want

explanations.overview: GraphQL lets clients request only the fields they need.

byOptionId.a: Not quite. GraphQL is usually JSON, not XML.
byOptionId.b: Correct. You pick the fields you need.
byOptionId.c: Not quite. GraphQL often runs over HTTP.
byOptionId.d: Not quite. GraphQL usually uses HTTP.

options.label: The server calls you when something happens

explanations.overview: Webhooks send a message to your server when an event happens.

byOptionId.a: Correct. The server pushes events to you.
byOptionId.b: Not quite. Webhooks are not storage.
byOptionId.c: Not quite. Webhooks do not replace databases.
byOptionId.d: Not quite. Webhooks require a network.

explanations.overview: WebSocket keeps a live connection for fast updates.

byOptionId.a: Correct. It is for real-time data.
byOptionId.d: Not quite. File names are unrelated.
